run_clip_similarity_evaluation: run CLIP-based visual similarity evaluation on HTML trajectories saved in a JSONL file
run_preference_pair_generation: run preference pair generation from trajectory results using CLIP similarity scores
run_best_of_k_evaluation: run best-of-k evaluation to find the highest reward trajectory for each task
run_html_rendering_with_drivers: run concurrent HTML rendering using Selenium drivers to generate ground truth images
run_trajectory_reward_calculation: run reward calculation using cosine similarity between answer and ground truth images
